name: Cubing in Campbellsville 2023
information:
All proceeds from this competition will be going to the family of Bryson Skaggs. Bryson was a 2023 graduate of Taylor County High School. He was involved in a car crash on August 4th, 2023 and sadly passed away. 

We will be holding cube raffles throughout the day to raise money for his family. 

|  |
| -------- |

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
